title: AI Swallowed Two Thirds Of All Startup Cash

beats.text: Quick question. Out of every ten dollars investors poured into startups this summer, how many went to AI? More than six!
beats.image_prompt: Glowing stream of golden coins pouring into a giant luminous futuristic brain made of circuits, dark cinematic background, vertical composition

beats.text: New data from Crunchbase says startups worldwide raised one hundred fifty nine billion dollars in the third quarter. One hundred two billion of that went to AI companies. That is sixty four percent.
beats.image_prompt: Enormous glowing pie chart floating above a night city skyline, two thirds lit in electric blue, no text

beats.text: But here is the wild part. A record twenty seven companies raised rounds of one billion dollars or more. Last quarter it was sixteen. The quarter before that... fourteen.
beats.image_prompt: Three skyscrapers rising in increasing height at night, the tallest blazing with neon light, dramatic low angle

beats.text: Databricks and Safe Superintelligence each landed five billion dollars. Eight companies pulled in at least three billion each!
beats.image_prompt: Eight shining vaults opening at once with golden light spilling out, cinematic, high contrast

beats.text: And get this. About one third of all venture money on the planet went to just those twenty seven companies.
beats.image_prompt: A single giant magnet pulling streams of glowing coins from across a dark world map, cinematic

beats.text: Even more surprising, about half the money went to companies founded since twenty twenty two. These startups are four years old or younger... and they are already raising billions.
beats.image_prompt: A tiny seedling growing into a gigantic glowing neon tree towering over a city, time lapse feeling

beats.text: Is it all going up? Not quite. Total funding was down twenty five percent from the second quarter. But it is still up fifty three percent from a year ago.
beats.image_prompt: A roller coaster of glowing light trails climbing, dipping and climbing again over a dark skyline

beats.text: So why should you care? When this much money chases one idea, it decides what gets built. More AI in your apps, your work, and your phone. Fast.
beats.image_prompt: Person silhouette holding a smartphone glowing with swirling blue AI patterns in a dark room, over the shoulder view

beats.text: The risk? Money this concentrated means giant winners... and giant losers if the hype cools.
beats.image_prompt: A tall tower of glowing blocks balanced precariously, wobbling, stormy sky behind, dramatic

beats.text: Watch the next quarter. Will the billion dollar club keep growing, or has the party peaked? Like and follow, and I will keep tracking where the money goes.
beats.image_prompt: Futuristic crystal ball showing a glowing city of data and light, mysterious dark background
